rules.sentence: Drug-induced parkinsonism presents with symptoms similar to Parkinson disease, including tremors, rigidity, and bradykinesia.
Key indicators of medication-induced parkinsonism, aside from the temporal relationship to starting the offending drug, include the symmetry and widespread nature of motor symptoms.
Toxin-induced parkinsonism is characterized by increased muscle tone leading to cogwheel rigidity, bradykinesia, and a higher risk of falling when attempting to walk backward.[42]
